mapper.select: SELECT org01_code.org01_code_id AS code_id , org02_info.org02_parent_code_id AS parent_code_id , 0 AS depth , org02_info.org02_kor_nm AS kor_name , org01_code.org01_org_cd AS org_code , COALESCE(dcr03_org_auth.dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') AS retrieve_yn , COALESCE(dcr03_org_auth.dcr03_update_yn, 'false') AS update_yn , org02_info.org02_note AS note FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON org01_code_id = org02_code_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth ON ( org01_code_id = dcr03_org_code_id AND dcr03_class_tree_id = #{dcrCodeId} ) WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND org02_parent_code_id = #{parentCodeId} AND f_sysdate() BETWEEN org01_open_date AND COALESCE(org01_close_date, to_date('99991231', 'yyyymmdd')) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = org02_info.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= f_sysdate() ) ORDER BY org02_sort_order

WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree( dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, dcr01_seq, dcr01_note, dcr01_class_tree_cd, dcr01_type_cd, depth, path, cycle ) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_note, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = 0 AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE '%' UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_note, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE '%' AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, a.depth - 1 AS depth, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, COALESCE(b.dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') AS retrieve_yn, COALESCE(b.dcr03_update_yn, 'false') AS update_yn, a.dcr01_seq AS seq, a.dcr01_note AS note FROM dcr_tree a LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth b ON ( a.dcr01_class_tree_id = b.dcr03_class_tree_id AND b.dcr03_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId} ) WHERE a.dcr01_type_cd IN ('T','C') ORDER BY a.path, a.dcr01_seq

WITH RECURSIVE dcr_down_tree(dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_company_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, 1, ARRAY[a.dcr01_parent_tree_id || a.dcr01_seq::text], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id || a.dcr01_seq::text), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_down_tree b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND NOT cycle ) SELECT dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, dcr01_company_id AS company_id FROM dcr_down_tree
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr01_class_tree WHERE dcr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND dcr01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org01_code WHERE org01_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND org01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT sys01_dcr_detail_use_yn FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr30_link WHERE dcr30_company_id = #{companyId} AND dcr30_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
